item.title: Car rams into NYC Chabad house repeatedly, driver arrested
item.description: A man was arrested Wednesday night after repeatedly driving his car into the entrance of Chabad Lubavitch World Headquarters in Crown Heights, Brooklyn, during a major holy celebration. The NYPD's hate crime task force is investigating the incident, which occurred at 8:45 p.m. as thousands of congregants celebrated Yud Shevat. item.title: Paris abandons opposition to IRGC terrorist listing as EU weighs sanctions

item.title: Trump considers strikes on Iranian leaders to fuel 'regime change' environment
item.description: US President Donald Trump is considering targeted military strikes against Iranian security forces and leaders to encourage domestic protests, according to Reuters.
